legalEntity: Exact legal name of the contracting entity
brokerPartner: Name of the licensed broker-dealer partner (for example an Alpaca or DriveWealth entity)
attorneyName: Name, firm and bar admission of the reviewing securities attorney
chiefComplianceOfficer: Name of the CCO responsible for the trading program
supervisoryPrincipal: Name of the registered principal supervising order flow
customerAuthorizationVersion: Version id of the customer trading authorization / account agreement
riskControlsReviewUrl: Internal URL of the reviewed risk controls (duplicate-order prevention, limits, reconciliation, kill switch)
